subject.title: Add Rovo Dev provider with monthly credit tracking

question: Should CodexBar ship Rovo Dev tracking only after a verified site-selection contract is available, or should this provider use a different supported source of usage data?
rationale: The endpoint and Basic-auth scheme are undocumented while the actual quota allocation is site-scoped, so selecting a durable request mechanism requires maintainer product and compatibility judgment.

options.title: Require verified site-aware API support
options.body: Keep the provider paused until the billing-site request contract is confirmed from an authoritative source or entitled-account verification and covered by focused tests.

options.title: Use a supported local source
options.body: Redesign the provider around a stable, site-aware CLI or local configuration data path if it can provide trustworthy usage data.

options.title: Defer the provider
options.body: Do not ship this experimental integration until Atlassian exposes a stable usage contract.

recommendation.title: Require verified site-aware API support
recommendation.body: Keep the provider paused until the billing-site request contract is confirmed from an authoritative source or entitled-account verification and covered by focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He has already identified the protocol blocker and is the current decision-maker for whether the integration lands.
